relevance_note: The paper describes three named siblings with the ABCA1 variant: "all carrying the Y1698X mutation in ABCA1, in homozygosity in two patients (Pt. 1 and 2) and in heterozygosity in one patient (Pt. 3)".
method_note: Hand-read; a short Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON from hand-written values (no table transcribed by script). Labels: the paper uses 'Patient 1/2/3' most often (also 'Pt. 1', 'Pat 1'). Phenotypic features come from the Results and Discussion text; per-nerve values in Table 1 were not transcribed into separate rows because the converted table splits the header (patient names appear only in the first fragment, followed by R/L columns), so per-patient column alignment is not certain; the text summaries were used instead. Table 2 (ultrasound NCSA) values were not recorded per nerve; the group statement 'NCSA of all nerve trunks, brachial plexus and roots were within the normal values' was used to exclude increased nerve cross-sectional area for all three studied patients (inferred from group statement). 'Cervical MRI was unremarkable' (Patient 1) is recorded as 'abnormal cervical MRI' excluded, a whole-investigation statement that excludes nothing more specific. Patient 3 is heterozygous for Y1698X, yet the paper calls all three 'patients ... with Tangier disease'; disease label recorded as stated for all three. Patient 3's HDL is printed as '44 mg/dl (normal >45mg/dl)'; recorded low HDL as observed because the value is below the printed normal, though the paper does not use the word 'low'. Peripheral neuropathy checklist item marked observed from each patient's nerve conduction findings (reduced SNAPs, axonal loss). Possible inconsistency: the text says Patient 2 had SNAP reduction 'in the right sural nerve', while Table 1 shows asterisks on both sural columns of what appears to be Patient 2; not resolved. Parents are described only as 'unaffected consanguineous parents', neither tested nor affected, so they get no rows. Normal controls are mentioned without a number. Publication year is not printed in the document (year null). Y1698X is protein-level notation without a 'p.' prefix; recorded as printed in both variant_original_string and protein_hgvs_as_stated; no cDNA or transcript is printed.
